# PollSlide

> PollSlide runs live polls, quizzes, surveys and Q&A over the slides you already have — Keynote, PowerPoint, Google Slides or a PDF. The audience scans a QR code and answers on their own phones (no app, no sign-up); results appear instantly. Free to start. Made by PollSlide Technologies LLC.

PollSlide is one suite of products on the same account:
- **PollSlide** — live audience polls and Q&A during a presentation.
- **SurveySlide** — async surveys and forms people answer in their own time.
- **QuizSlide** — graded quizzes and game modes (speed rounds, streaks, survival, wagers, team play) — also used as pub quiz software.
- **StudySlide** — flashcards with spaced repetition, streaks and study games.
- **LoopSlide** — questions that loop on a TV or venue screen with live leaderboards.
- **PresentSlide** — import a deck (PDF or images) and present it from PollSlide, with live polls, quizzes and reveals built in.

On the audience's phone:
- Questions appear in the language each phone is set to, translated live into 11 languages (English, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Japanese, Chinese, Arabic, Hindi); a "See original" tap shows the exact wording, and the presenter can keep any question in its original language.
- Images, GIFs and video on questions and answers show on the phone.
- After the reveal, each phone shows Correct / Partly right / Not quite plus the right answer.
- Answers are kept and re-sent if the connection drops; team play, class rosters with PIN/code/email check-in, and a gradebook export are built in.

How it works with each presentation tool:
- **Keynote (Mac):** paste a QR onto any slide; the free PollSlide Companion for Mac floats live results over the deck and follows along as you present.
- **PowerPoint:** works today with a QR on any slide, no plugin needed; a native PowerPoint add-in is in review with Microsoft.
- **Google Slides:** paste a QR onto any slide; the audience votes on their phones.
- **Anything else** (PDF, webpage, video): present from PollSlide or use the Mac companion overlay.

Polly, the built-in AI, drafts questions from a topic or from your own material (PDF or notes), and groups open answers into themes.
